$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/plant.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office keeps the machine register (classes, symptoms, machines), triages requests and plans maintenance jobs through apps/factory-api's modules/plant (B-W2a-35), always through command(); the API keeps staff to the companies and sites their grants reach. The floor (factory_floor_runtime) reads the classes and symptoms, tenant-wide (the station's symptom tiles: words and icons, nothing personal or secret), and its site's machines (never what they cost: purchaseCost is hidden), requests and jobs. A station reports a problem (floor.machine: a request) and marks the machine down, or unsafe at once (Owner answer H1: anyone at the station; the machine DO_NOT_USE in the same command); a technician (the API's permission) starts and hands back the jobs of the site and signs a locked machine safe with the PIN. The …_quality_plant_w2a_guards triggers keep the floor to those changes (a machine's status, a request's sign-safe, a job's work and hand-back) and hold the lock: an unsafe request not signed safe keeps its machine DO_NOT_USE. The floor never makes or numbers a job, never retires a machine. Portal and link sessions read nothing here. Nothing is deleted: classes and symptoms are set inactive, machines retired, requests closed, jobs cancelled. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

MachineClass.about: The office keeps the machine classes; every floor device reads them (the class word and icon of a machine).

MachineSymptom.about: The office keeps the symptoms per class; every floor device reads them for the station's symptom tiles (an unsafe one marks the machine unsafe at once).

Machine.about: The office keeps the site's machines (place, supplier, cost, status) and retires them. The site's floor reads them without the cost (the station's machine, the technician's job card) and changes only the status: down or unsafe at once from a report, under maintenance and running again from a job, after the sign-safe.

MaintenanceRequest.about: The office reports, triages, merges and closes requests and makes jobs from them. The site's floor reads them, reports a problem from the station (a request, unsafe at once when it is), and a technician signs an unsafe one safe with the PIN.

MaintenanceJob.about: The office makes jobs (number from the company's MAINTENANCE_JOB series), assigns, plans, closes and cancels them. The site's floor reads them (a technician's My jobs) and a technician starts, pauses for parts and hands back its work.
